doc.title: Packaging Material Specifications and Approved Suppliers
doc.file: QP-309 Packaging Material Specifications and Approved Suppliers.pdf
doc.purpose: Hold in one place the specification and the approved supplier for each packaging material.

roles.name: Quality Manager
roles.does: Owns this document and approves suppliers.

roles.name: Purchasing
roles.does: Buys only from the suppliers listed here.

references.as_written: QP-308 Incoming Inspection of Packaging Materials

parameters.quote: Liner caliper 0.075 mm plus or minus 0.005; barcode grade C or better
A new or second supplier needs a line trial of at least one full shift

rules.statement: The Quality Manager owns the document and approves suppliers; a new or second supplier needs a line trial and a signed FRM-QA-09 before first production order.
rules.quote: A new or second supplier needs a line trial of at least one full shift and a signed FRM-QA-09 Supplier Approval Record

rules.topic: which suppliers' packaging may be used
rules.statement: Purchasing buys only from the approved supplier in the table.
rules.quote: Buy packaging materials only from the approved supplier in the table below.

rules.statement: Characteristics marked critical must be measured on every lot by the QA Technician; label liner caliper is critical.
rules.quote: Characteristics marked critical below must be measured on every lot.

rules.topic: documents to update after supplier approval
rules.statement: After approval the Quality Manager updates QP-309, QP-308 and the label and cap setup instructions before the material is used.
rules.quote: After approval, update this document, QP-308 and the label and cap setup instructions before the material is used.
